episodes.name: A Faceful of Danger!
episodes.overviewEn: The evil Loki makes plans to take down Spider-Man by overloading Doctor Octopus and taking control of him using the Norn Frost snowball.

episodes.name: Obnoxious Mandarin!
episodes.overviewEn: Mandarin attacks Iron Man's Malibu Mansion. Will Iron Man and Pepper Potts save the mansion before Mandarin reduces it to a pile of rubble?

episodes.name: Operation Doofus Drop!
episodes.overviewEn: Loki overloads Abomination, the huge gamma-monster. Can Iron Man, Iron Fist, and The Hulk stop him?

episodes.name: Assault, Off-Asgard!
episodes.overviewEn: Loki sets his mind-controlled villains loose. Can Spider-Man, Thor, and Iron Man team up with S.H.I.E.L.D. to stop Loki's overloaded team?
